# `navmesh` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "navmesh" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/navmesh/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | The scene it was baked from (its id). |
| `version` | `1` | required | Bake version. |
| `source` | string | required | Fingerprint of everything the bake read. |
| `settings` | object | required | The agent and grid it was baked for; `pnpm nav:bake` keeps them on a re-bake. |
| `settings.cellSize` | number > 0 | required | Bake cell size, m. |
| `settings.agentRadius` | number > 0 | required | Agent radius the walkable area is shrunk by, m. |
| `settings.agentHeight` | number > 0 | required | Headroom a walkable surface needs, m. |
| `settings.stepHeight` | number ≥ 0 | required | Tallest step between neighbouring cells, m. |
| `settings.maxSlope` | number ≥ 0 < 90 | required | Steepest walkable slope, degrees. |
| `settings.maxJump` | number ≥ 0 | required | Highest jump link baked, m. |
| `settings.maxDrop` | number ≥ 0 | required | Highest drop link baked, m. |
| `origin` | list of any (at least 2) | required | World x, z of cell corner (0, 0), m. |
| `polys` | list of list of any (at least 9) | required | Walkable rectangles, one row each: [i0, k0, i1, k1, a, gx, gz, area, door] — cells [i0, i1) × [k0, k1), surface y = a + gx·x + gz·z, nav area index, door index or −1. |
| `portals` | list of list of any (at least 6) | required | Edges shared by two rectangles: [a, b, i0, k0, i1, k1] — polygons a < b, edge from cell corner (i0, k0) to (i1, k1). |
| `links` | list of list of any (at least 10) | required | Off-mesh links, one way: [kind, from, to, ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz, measure] — kind index (jump, drop, climb…), polygons, end points in metres, rise/fall or climb grade. |
| `doors` | list of id | required | Door spawn ids; a polygon’s `door` indexes this list. |
